# Incident Response Handbook

## Severity levels

SEV-1 means a widespread production outage or confirmed data loss. Page the incident commander immediately and open the public status channel within ten minutes.

SEV-2 means a major feature is unavailable without widespread data loss. Acknowledge the page within fifteen minutes and post an internal update every thirty minutes.

## Recovery objectives

The payments service has a recovery time objective of thirty minutes and a recovery point objective of five minutes. The analytics warehouse has a four-hour recovery time objective.
